About OnBoard

Boards set the standard for what organizations can achieve. At OnBoard, we help boards function at a higher level so every organization can make a bigger difference in the world.

Join The Team

Why We're Here

Everything we do is centered on helping boards govern effectively. We understand that the board sets the pace for an organization's success, and our mission is to enhance every facet of their work. Our integrated solutions streamline agenda planning, simplify decision-making, and ensure seamless board member collaboration. This allows leaders to direct their full attention to strategic goals and drive their organizations toward lasting achievements.

Accelerate Decisions

We accelerate the ability of boards to shape the future of their organizations by removing friction and complexity from their work, so every decision is as informed and effective as possible.

Align Strategies

We help boards align their organization's strategic direction, creating a symphony of focused planning and unified execution.

Anticipate Challenges

We anticipate the challenges boards and leadership teams will face, working together with directors, executives, and administrators to meet their needs as they grow and change.

Advocate For Collaboration

We advocate a more collaborative world, using the latest technology and boldest thinking to expand what’s possible for organizations to achieve, one team—and one meeting—at a time.

What We Value

OnBoard is anchored by the ideals of diversity, equity, and 'Sahyog'—our commitment to collaboration. We honor our rich heritage by fostering a culture of transparency and innovation that empowers leaders and organizations to thrive.

Commitment to Diversity

At OnBoard, we champion diversity within our products, teams, and the communities we serve, believing that a breadth of experiences and backgrounds enriches our mission and the effectiveness of every board.

Sahyog - Culture of Togetherness

The principle of Sahyog, meaning collaboration, permeates our culture. We thrive on mutual accountability, creativity, and an overarching commitment to transparency and excellence.

Heritage of Excellence

With roots on Purdue University's campus, OnBoard's long history in enhancing board governance spans over two decades, serving thousands of organizations across the globe.

Who We Are

We are governance experts, technologists, and thought leaders. Driven by a commitment to honesty and open innovation, we view every challenge as an opportunity to learn and excel. Together, we are OnBoard, the partners for today's dynamic leaders and boards.
